macros.name: newtotcounter
macros.doc: The macro \newtotcounter is a shorthand for creating a new counter and registering it as a total counter.

macros.name: regtotcounter
macros.doc: Registers a counter as a total counter.

macros.name: total
macros.doc: Prints the total value of a registered total counter that is passed as argument.

macros.name: totvalue
macros.doc: Returns the numeric total value of a registered total counter that is passed as argument.

macros.name: usetotcountfile
macros.doc: Inputs an auxiliary file that should contain total-counter definitions.
